paragraphs.text: More young people than ever are volunteering, and many hope that the experience will help them find a job. Employers generally agree that volunteering can make an application stronger, but not always for the reasons applicants expect.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: What most employers look for is evidence of commitment. A person who has helped at the same organisation every week for a year shows reliability, whereas a list of one-day events says little.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Volunteering can also demonstrate skills that are hard to prove in other ways. Organising a fundraising event, for example, involves planning, managing money and persuading people to take part.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: However, applicants often describe their volunteering poorly. Instead of explaining what they achieved, they simply name the organisation. Recruiters suggest giving specific examples, such as how much money was raised.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Finally, volunteering should not be done only to improve a CV. Employers can usually tell when an interest is not genuine, and applicants who chose a cause they care about tend to speak about it more convincingly.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: many hope that the experience will help them find a job

explanation.en: Volunteering is popular (“More young people than ever”) and many hope it “will help them find a job” → iv.
explanation.kk: Еріктілік танымал («More young people than ever»), көпшілігі ол «will help them find a job» деп үміттенеді → iv.
explanation.ru: Волонтёрство популярно («More young people than ever»), и многие надеются, что оно «will help them find a job» → iv.

items.quote: A person who has helped at the same organisation every week for a year shows reliability

explanation.en: Employers want reliability: helping “every week for a year shows reliability” → i “Showing you can be relied on”.
explanation.kk: Жұмыс берушіге сенімділік маңызды: «every week for a year shows reliability» → i «Showing you can be relied on».
explanation.ru: Работодателям важна надёжность: помощь «every week for a year shows reliability» → i «Showing you can be relied on».

items.quote: Volunteering can also demonstrate skills that are hard to prove in other ways

explanation.en: “demonstrate skills that are hard to prove” — planning, money, persuasion → v. Fundraising is an example of skills, not how charities recruit (vii).
explanation.kk: «demonstrate skills that are hard to prove» — жоспарлау, ақша, сендіру → v. Қаражат жинау — дағдылардың мысалы, қайырымдылық ұйымдары ерікті қалай іздейді (vii) деген тақырып емес.
explanation.ru: «demonstrate skills that are hard to prove» — планирование, деньги, умение убеждать → v. Сбор средств — пример навыков, а не тема о том, как благотворительные организации ищут волонтёров (vii).

items.quote: applicants often describe their volunteering poorly

explanation.en: After “However” comes a common error: “applicants often describe their volunteering poorly” → iii “Common mistakes in applications”.
explanation.kk: «However» сөзінен кейін — жиі кездесетін қате: «applicants often describe their volunteering poorly» → iii «Common mistakes in applications».
explanation.ru: После «However» — типичная ошибка: «applicants often describe their volunteering poorly» → iii «Common mistakes in applications».

items.quote: Employers can usually tell when an interest is not genuine

explanation.en: Employers can tell “when an interest is not genuine” → ii “Real interest matters”.
explanation.kk: Жұмыс берушілер «when an interest is not genuine» екенін байқайды → ii «Real interest matters».
explanation.ru: Работодатели видят, «when an interest is not genuine» → ii «Real interest matters».
